items.title: Sinner extends record run with Miami win
items.summary: Jannik Sinner takes his record for the most consecutive sets won at ATP Masters 1,000 events to 28 as he reaches the quarter-finals of the Miami Open.

items.title: Gauff battles imposter syndrome to reach first Miami Open semi-final
items.summary: Coco Gauff becomes the youngest American to reach the women's singles semi-finals at the Miami Open since Serena Williams in 2004.

items.title: Sinner surpasses Djokovic's Masters 1000 record
items.summary: Jannik Sinner surpasses Novak Djokovic's 10-year record for consecutive sets won at ATP Masters 1000 events in his Miami Open win over Corentin Moutet.

items.title: Gauff to face Sabalenka in her first Miami Open final
items.summary: American Coco Gauff cruises past 13th seed Karolina Muchova in straight sets to reach her first Miami Open final, where world number one Aryna Sabalenka awaits.

items.title: Sinner continues remarkable run as he cruises into semis
items.summary: Jannik Sinner claims his 29th and 30th consecutive sets at ATP Masters 1,000 events as he cruises past American Frances Tiafoe into the semi-finals of the Miami Open.
